# Summit Lighting Co.

> Professional Christmas light installation company serving Utah County, Salt Lake
> County, and Wasatch County, Utah. Every quote includes commercial-grade LED
> lights, custom design, installation, season-long maintenance, takedown, and
> free year-round storage. Phone: (801) 598-8307. Email: info@summitlightingco.com.

Summit Lighting Co. is a locally-owned holiday lighting installer serving Utah
County, Utah. Customers do not purchase or store any lights: all commercial-grade
LED lights, clips, cords, and timers are provided and stored by the company
year-round. Typical residential installation takes 2-4 hours. Installation runs
early October through early December; takedown happens in January. Booking is
recommended in September or early October.

Service area includes Provo, Orem, Lehi, Draper, and Sandy, plus surrounding
communities across Utah County, Salt Lake County, and Wasatch County.

## Services

- [Residential Christmas Light Installation](https://summitlightingco.com/#services): Custom design, all lights and equipment provided, professional installation, season-long maintenance.
- [Commercial Holiday Lighting](https://summitlightingco.com/#services): Large-scale displays, energy-efficient LEDs, flexible scheduling.
- [Custom Design Service](https://summitlightingco.com/#services): Warm white, cool white, multicolor, and custom color combinations.
- [Maintenance & Warranty](https://summitlightingco.com/#services): Free bulb replacement, included repairs, storm damage support, timer adjustments.

## Key Facts

- [How It Works](https://summitlightingco.com/#programs): Free quote, custom design, professional install (2-4 hours for most homes), maintenance, takedown, and free storage.
- [FAQ](https://summitlightingco.com/#faq): Lights included in every quote; free in-season repairs; installs from early October; takedown in January; free year-round storage and next-season reinstallation.
